Push current secret/keypair or full vault into the Variable Vault for secure packaging and storage.

Outbound lane: generated secrets and PEM env blocks queue straight into the Variable Vault.
Inbound lane: Vault pushes environment packs back here as queued .env workspace files for the browser runner.
